issue.title: Daily job fires twice across DST
issue.body: At the autumn DST transition, a daily 01:30 job executes twice for the repeated local time.

candidates.title: Daily job skipped in spring
candidates.body: At the spring DST transition, 02:30 does not exist and the daily job is skipped.

candidates.title: Autumn repeated hour duplicates a run
candidates.body: A scheduled daily 01:30 run executes twice during the fall clock rollback.

candidates.title: UTC display
candidates.body: Show UTC timestamps in the audit UI.
